create_owlv2_image_processor: create an Owlv2ImageProcessor instance for preprocessing images for OWL-V2 object detection
run_post_process_object_detection: run post_process_object_detection to convert model logits into final bounding boxes with a confidence threshold
run_post_process_image_guided_detection: run post_process_image_guided_detection to convert model output into COCO-format detections with NMS filtering
test_box_iou: test the box_iou function that computes pairwise IoU between two sets of bounding boxes in (x1,y1,x2,y2) format
summarize_resize: summarize the resize method that resamples images with optional Gaussian anti-aliasing before resizing
